messages.text: British doubles No 1 criticises ATP bosses at trophy presentation absence

metadata.summary: British doubles No 1 Henry Patten has taken a swipe at ATP bosses for their absence from a trophy presentation in Turin on Monday.
metadata.content: Henry Patten: British doubles No 1 takes swipe at ATP chairman and CEO for absence from trophy presentation | Tennis News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Henry Patten: British doubles No 1 takes swipe at ATP chairman and CEO for absence from trophy presentation Henry Patten uses trophy presentation to focus on the absence of ATP bosses, reigniting his opposition to the doubles reform expected for 2028; You can watch the ATP Finals in Turin this week on Sky Sports Tennis Monday 16 November 2026 20:40, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player British doubles star Henry Patten hit out at ATP chairman Andrea Gaudenzi and CEO Eno Polo for missing his world No 1 trophy presentation British doubles No 1 Henry Patten has taken a swipe at ATP bosses for their absence from a trophy presentation in Turin on Monday. Upon receiving the year-end doubles No 1 trophy from chief tour officer Andre Silva, alongside his Finnish partner Harri Heliovaara, Patten called out the ATP chairman Andrea Gaudenzi and CEO Eno Polo. "For us, it's a really big deal. It's a real shame that the ATP chairman and CEO don't think the same." Patten said. messages.text: Ratcliffe's Ineos Group settles £10m-plus claim with Ainslie's firm over yacht

metadata.summary: A company connected to Sir Jim Ratcliffe's Ineos Group said it has settled a High Court claim against a firm founded by Sir Ben Ainslie.
metadata.content: Jim Ratcliffe's Ineos Group settles £10m-plus claim with Sir Ben Ainslie's Athena Racing over alleged non-return of yacht | Sailing News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Jim Ratcliffe's Ineos Group settles £10m-plus claim with Sir Ben Ainslie's Athena Racing over alleged non-return of yacht Ineos Racing sued Athena Racing earlier this year, alleging the latter breached a deal between the two companies by refusing to return multimillion-pound yacht; Sir Ben Ainslie's GB1 team is the challenger of record for the next America's Cup in Naples, Italy in 2027 Monday 16 November 2026 13:03, UK Image: A company connected to Sir Jim Ratcliffe's Ineos Group said it has settled a High Court claim against a firm founded by Sir Ben Ainslie A company connected to Sir Jim Ratcliffe's Ineos Group said it has settled a High Court claim against a firm founded by Sir Ben Ainslie. Ineos Racing sued Athena Racing earlier this year, alleging the latter breached a deal between the two companies by refusing to return the multimillion-pound yacht Ineos Britannia, which Ainslie captained at the 2024 America's Cup in a 7-2 defeat to Emirates Team New Zealand in Barcelona. Lawyers for Ineos said in court documents filed earlier this year that the claim was valued at more than £10 million. Sky Sports on WhatsApp: Breaking news, videos and analysis Not got Sky? metadata.summary: Andy Robertson has broken the record for the most senior Scotland men's team caps, surpassing the feat held by Sir Kenny Dalglish for 40 years.
metadata.content: Andy Robertson: Scotland captain breaks national appearance record by winning 103rd senior cap vs Switzerland | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Andy Robertson: Scotland captain breaks national appearance record by winning 103rd senior cap vs Switzerland Andy Robertson became Scotland's most-capped player with start against Switzerland in Nations League; he passed Kenny Dalglish's record of 102 caps; Robertson on Sir Kenny: "I don't want to forget and I don't want people to forget how important this man has been for our country." Monday 16 November 2026 20:58, UK Image: Andy Robertson has become Scotland's most capped player Andy Robertson has broken the record for the most senior Scotland men's team caps, surpassing the feat held by Sir Kenny Dalglish for 40 years. The Scotland captain made his 103rd appearance for the national side in Monday's Nations League's game against Switzerland. He has bypassed the record set by Dalglish, who earned 102 caps between 1971 and 1986.
